string.text: Professor Markov's order #3

Markov handed me some kind of artifact. Near the Bar, a zombified stalker has shown up again in one of the apartment buildings. He offered me a job that kills two birds with one stone: get rid of the troublesome stalker and run an experiment at the same time. I need to plant this artifact right next to the zombified stalker. It should disintegrate him completely.
Conduct an experiment with a stalker
Talk to Professor Markov
Professor Markov's order #2
Markov messed with that artifact from the first order. Now it needs to be exposed to high temperatures.
Throw the artifact into the Mincer anomaly
Talk to Professor Markov
Search for the unusual artifact
A scientist on the roof of the Bar asked me to find a strange artifact called the "Disintegrator". Weird...
Find the artifact "Disintegrator"
Bring the artifact to Professor Markov

A repairman at the Bar offers to trade the unique jumpsuit belonging to a stalker nicknamed Golmar for the following items: 
- A Mercenary Suit 
- An "EX-04" Scientific Suit 
- A G36 Assault Rifle 
- Five bottles of vodka. 
Alternatively, he will sell it for ten thousand dollars.
Golmar's suit
Pack items or make money
Bring what Amethyst needs
Artifact Specialist Group Order #1

"Our group is studying a type of anomalous formation that locals call the Magnet artifact. I've uploaded the data to your PDA, the document describes its basic properties. The thing is, this artifact has very interesting anti-gravity wave properties that we're researching. Right now we're short on materials for our experiments, so if you come across any Magnet artifacts, bring them to us. If the experiments go well, we can reward you handsomely."
Find the artifact "Magnet"
Bring the artifact to the group leader
Artifact Specialist Group Order #2
The scientists who specialize in magnetic artifacts need two more artifacts for further research.
Find two artifacts "Magnet"
Bring the artifacts to the group leader
Artifact Specialist Group Order #3
These scientists must be working on something important. Now they're asking for two magnetic artifacts for further study, plus an Electric Ball artifact.
Find two artifacts: "Magnet" and "Electric Ball"
Bring the artifacts to the group leader
Artifact Specialist Group Order #4

Those scientists gave me this artifact. Now they want me to toss it into an Electro anomaly, fish it out afterwards, and bring it back so they can study it. I wonder why they can't just do this shit themselves...
Throw the artifact into the "Mincer" and bring the result
Return to group leader
Artifact Specialist Group Order #5
Once again, the scientists gave me another order. They want me to find a gauss rifle magazine - preferably one that still has a charge and some slugs in it.
Find a magazine from a Gauss rifle
Bring the Gauss rifle magazine to the group leader
Artifact Specialist Group Order #6

No surprise, the scientists who study magnetic artifacts gave me another strange order. They want me to bring them a VSS Vintorez. Everyone in the Zone already carries a gun, so I have no idea why the hell they'd need one - let alone a VSS... but I'll get it for them anyway.
Find VSS Vintorez
Bring the weapon to the group leader
Artifact Specialist Group Order #7

These nerds aren't as innocent as they seem. Turns out they're working for the Ukrainian military. Well, free army gear is always welcome in the Zone. I need to test-fire a few hundred rounds from a prototype Vintorez that has anomalous magnetic properties. Some bits of a magnetic artifact have been built into it. After I'm finished, I have to give the rifle back to the scientists.
Fire several hundred shots from an experimental weapon
Return the weapon to the group leader
Meet the Witcher
On my way to the Bar, Witcher messaged me and asked to meet up.
